author: anamika29
title: Worst Products, Poor Service!
review: Many people may disagree with me because I’m sharing my worst shopping experience with the renowned site Myntra. I had very high expectations for the product ordered, due to its great reputation. But, unfortunately, the product's quality was too cheap. I got shocked that how the products are of so cheap quality. Not only the product's quality, but I also faced multiple issues in the platform. I ordered a few dresses to wear to my friend’s wedding. The issue began with the delivery. Although the estimated delivery date was just 4 days later, I placed the order. But due to packaging delays, it was repeatedly delayed without any clear explanation. The tracking updates were also inconsistent, and there was very little communication regarding the status of my order. As a customer, I expected timely updates rather than having to check the app for information repeatedly. As I said earlier, the dresses I ordered were not good, so I had to return them, which was another major disappointment. While Myntra claims to offer hassle-free returns, my experience was far from simple. The return request took longer than expected to be processed, and the guy came very late to receive the products. After the products were picked up by their delivery agent, ideally, the return amount should be credited after the quality check, but this also didn’t happen. The money was not credited, so after waiting for one week, I called the customer care again, discussed the issue, wasted my time, and then the money got credited to my account. Overall, my experience with Myntra was disappointing due to delayed delivery, poor product quality, an inconvenient return process, and unhelpful customer support. While other customers may have had better experiences, mine did not meet even the basic expectations. I would not recommend Myntra to anyone looking for a reliable shopping experience because other alternative platforms provide a more reliable and customer-friendly shopping experience, making them a better choice for online purchases.

title: Poor Product Quality, Difficult Return!
review: Myntra is a well-known online fashion platform, but my experience was somewhat disappointing. Although the platform is excellent, it offers products from multiple good brands. But due to the issue, I faced poor product quality and returns. Im cautious about trusting the site for future purchases. Product Quality I ordered three dresses from it with very high expectations, but unfortunately, the dress quality doesnt match my expectations. The fabric felt cheaper than described, and the stitching was also rough. Considering the price and brand name, I expected much better product quality. I have found that the product's quality is shown on the site. Exchange/ Return Experience The exchange and return are also not as smooth as advertised. Since the dress quality was not good, I decided to return it. I raised a return request, which was not accepted. When I called customer support, they initially refused the request, but after I explained it properly, they accepted and processed the return. But it was very frustrating. Final Verdict Overall, my experience with Myntra was not satisfactory. I faced multiple issues with the platform. Not only the product quality but the platform service was also extremely poor. While the platform offers a large range of products across various categories, the service and quality was really inconsistent. I would not recommend anyone to Myntra, rather than suggest you other excellent platforms available in the market.
